stem_book: Find expression for velocity as a function of time for the given graph (v–t graph: a straight line sloping downward that cuts the t-axis at t = c, making an angle α with the t-axis). (a) v = tanα(c + t) (b) v = tanα(−c + t) (c) v = tanα(c − t) (d) None of these
work: slope = −tanα, v = 0 at t = c ⇒ v = −tanα(t − c) = tanα(c − t)
